contest.desc: Teenagers competing in a school cooking contest at kitchen stations, a judge tasting dishes, plain walls with no signs or banners.

pirate.desc: A man in a pirate costume with an eye patch, tricorn hat and a parrot on his shoulder holding a treasure map, on a wooden ship deck.

rowing boat.desc: A wooden rowing boat with two oars on a calm lake in the morning.

strong.desc: Several generations of one family, grandparents, parents and teenagers, together lighting candles on a festive table the same way every year, warm and traditional.

symbolise.desc: A white dove holding an olive branch flying over a blue globe, a symbol of peace.

transform.desc: A caterpillar, a chrysalis and a butterfly in a row on a branch showing transformation, macro photo.

bright idea.desc: A teenage girl raising her finger with a sudden idea, a glowing light bulb above her head, excited face.

colourful street parade.desc: A bright colourful street parade: flower-covered floats and dancers in vivid fully covered costumes, crowd watching.

cooking contest.desc: Teenage cooks in chef hats presenting pies at a cooking contest, judges tasting, no signs.

enter a competition.desc: A teenage boy with a race number pinned on his T-shirt joining the line of runners at the start of a race.

fireworks display.desc: A big fireworks display over a river and city at night, a crowd watching from the embankment.

raise money for charity.desc: Teenagers selling homemade cookies at a school charity stall, coins going into a jar with a red heart on it.

spare change of clothes.desc: A mother packing a spare T-shirt and trousers into a backpack in case her son gets wet.

strong tradition.desc: Grandmother, mother and teenage daughter baking traditional Easter cakes together in a cosy kitchen.

a load of rubbish.desc: A teenage boy laughing and waving his hand dismissively at a friend's crazy story, rolling his eyes: nonsense.

attention.desc: A class of teenagers all looking attentively at the teacher at the board, full concentration.

coincidence.desc: Two teenage girls meeting at a party wearing exactly the same dress, both surprised and laughing.

four-leaf clover.desc: Macro photo of a four-leaf clover among ordinary three-leaf clovers.

full moon.desc: A huge round full moon rising over a sleeping village at night.

old wives' tale.desc: A grandmother by the fireplace telling an old story to her grandchildren who listen with doubtful smiles.

on one's mind.desc: A teenage girl at her desk staring out of the window, lost in thoughts, pencil in hand, homework forgotten.

pass one's exams.desc: Happy teenagers jumping and hugging after passing their exams outside a school.

reassure.desc: A mother hugging and calming her worried teenage son, gentle hand on his shoulder.
